eyebrow: Streaming a web-text corpus with datasets
code:
from datasets import load_dataset

ds = load_dataset("HuggingFaceFW/fineweb", split="train", streaming=True)

def basic_filter(example):
    text = example["text"]
    return len(text) > 200 and len(text) < 100_000

filtered = ds.filter(basic_filter)
caption: streaming=True reads and transforms terabytes of text without loading it all into memory.
